summary: Scott Krankkala, 22, fell 20-40 feet on the west side of Crested Butte Mountain above Grant Lake then tumbled down talus; serious head injuries, 3,200-ft rope lower
location: West side of Crested Butte Mountain, above Grant Lake
responding_agency: Crested Butte SAR + Western State College SAR
notes: Long technical night evacuation; victim was himself a SAR team member CBN 2011-07 'busy summer' feature mentions this mission (high-angle response on the cliffs of Crested Butte Mountain to rescue a fellow team member).
